visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long red hair, wearing a grey zip-up hoodie over a black top, ripped grey jeans, and a grey cap, stands in a grassy campground. She points upward towards a large beige canopy and a silver camper van parked behind her. The lighting is bright natural daylight, highlighting the green grass and stone-walled terraces. (2) High-angle drone shots reveal the campground's layout on a mountain ridge. Several wooden buildings with brown roofs, tents, and the silver van are nestled among lush green forests. The background features layers of hazy blue mountain ranges under a sky filled with soft white clouds. (3) A close-up shows a stainless steel cup filled with ice and clear water, resting on a wooden railing. In the blurred background, the deep green valleys and distant peaks are visible. (4) The scene transitions to dusk. A time-lapse captures the sky changing from orange and pink hues to a deep twilight purple. People are seen sitting in silhouette under the illuminated camping canopy near a warm, glowing campfire. (5) The woman walks towards a row of brown metal restroom and shower facilities. She points to the outdoor sinks, mirrors, and various doors labeled with Chinese characters. She opens one door to reveal a clean, white-tiled shower room with a black-and-white patterned floor. (6) She moves to show the toilet facilities, opening a door to display a clean, modern white toilet in a similarly tiled room. The lighting inside the facility is bright and functional. (7) Further drone shots capture the lower level of the campground, showcasing more tent spaces and the surrounding mountainous topography, emphasizing the scale of the environment.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 拉拉山 1400m 營地. [Subtitle]: 陽光 35 度 / 天幕 30 度. [Subtitle]: 晚上 18 度. [Subtitle]: 這次我們來到的是桃園的拉拉山. (2) [Subtitle]: 熊居露營趣營地. [Subtitle]: 那這邊的海拔呢 是 1400 公尺. (3) [Subtitle]: 這一區是 A 區九帳的空間. [Subtitle]: 集中式衛浴和集中式水槽. (4) [Subtitle]: 那前面就有大大的山景 view 給你可看. [Subtitle]: 我們盛夏 7 月來露營啊. [Subtitle]: 白天的溫度其實有高達 大概 三十五 三十六度. (5) [Subtitle]: 陽光直射很熱. [Subtitle]: 但是晚上也變 18 度那種. [Subtitle]: 超超級冷. (6) [Subtitle]: 所以這個日夜溫差真的非常大. [Subtitle]: 所以高海拔的地方 就是防曬和防寒都要做好準備. (7) [Subtitle]: 但是天幕下大概 30 度了. [Subtitle]: 而且是有風就涼. [Subtitle]: 帶大家看看衛浴吧. (8) [Subtitle]: 那這邊呢 就是它的洗手槽. [Subtitle]: 然後吹風機區. (9) [Subtitle]: 淋浴間總共有四間. [Subtitle]: 但是超大超乾淨. [Subtitle]: 大家請看. (10) [Subtitle]: 然后一间坐式兩間蹲式. [Subtitle]: 然后也都是乾淨的. (11) [Subtitle]: 那下面的話就是 B 區的空間. [Subtitle]: B 區是在比較下層. [Subtitle]: 大概是應該是目測五六帳吧.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: A high-altitude campground set on a terraced mountain ridge in Lalashan, featuring grassy plots, camping canopies, camper vans, and panoramic views of distant mountain ranges and valleys. Infrastructure includes brown metal restroom buildings with modern tiled interiors and outdoor sink stations.
